status: canonical; supersedes the corresponding claims in REVIEW_20261022_R1 §112-§127

items.defect: mu/sd fitted on the full X before cross-validation (preprocessing leakage); features are 56 sensor summaries and exclude cycle/settings used by the real model
items.action: recompute with all normalisation fitted inside each training fold; the leaked figure is withdrawn

items.defect: the window endpoint depends on future lifespan T; with cycle as an input, t≈T/2 mechanically reveals T, so this sampling cannot establish whether information exists or not
items.action: withdraw 'information limit', 'any structure is ineffective', 'conditional mean is already optimal'
items.replacement: on this retrospective sampling, these probes did not extract stable predictive power

items.defect: highly correlated predictions do not preclude a meaningful error correction; correlation is not a necessary condition for innovation or detectability
MDE depends on the specific pairing, variance, estimator and training randomness; overlapping splits are not independent samples; cross-split SD must not be multiplied by sqrt(52)
items.action: withdraw '5% statistically unreachable', 'needs 1460 engines universally', '21 non-significant pairs prove real differences exist'
items.replacement: report point estimates and CIs with their scope only

items.defect: sqrt(mean over seeds of squared errors) is a cross-seed RMS performance summary, not a predictive ensemble; a true ensemble averages member predictions on common keys first
items.action: rename the v2 quantity to cross-seed RMS; any true ensemble must use strictly common keys and be reported as a separate exploratory result, never as confirmation after selecting combinations on seen data

items.defect: corr=1.000000 does not establish that the residual difference is floating-point; a config or EMA difference is equally plausible
strongest fair baseline, same-feature Transformer, and simplified literature reproductions were described interchangeably
items.action: keep three separate labels; a simplified re-implementation must not be presented as a reproduction of the original method
